description: Use this to fully replace weekly availability for staffId in salonId with rules containing weekday and minute boundaries. Validates times and source capabilities, and previews the current and proposed schedule in the salon time zone; empty rules make the staff member unavailable when applied. Saves a preview without changing the calendar. Apply with beautyos_apply_change after explicit owner confirmation.
name: beautyos_staff_schedule_replace_prepare
title: Prepare weekly schedule replacement
